# Getting help

- Start with the
  [guides and API reference](https://mrdav30.github.io/Trailblazer/).
- Ask usage and integration questions in the
  [LSF Discord community](https://discord.gg/mhwK2QFNBA).
- Report bugs and request features through
  [GitHub issues](https://github.com/mrdav30/Trailblazer/issues). For a bug,
  include the package version, standard or Lean profile, target framework, and a
  small reproduction.
- Report vulnerabilities privately using the [security policy](../SECURITY.md).

See [Contributing](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for development and validation, and
follow the [Code of Conduct](../CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) in project spaces.
